method: Actual current game in headless Chromium. Fresh localhost QA/mockstore profile, seeded randomness, virtual clock and a capture-only startDepth/state export. Each target is rerendered at its own viewport and DPR. No shipping code edits, fabricated art, added prices or changed mechanics. Play contains six direct captures and two clearly framed marketing composites of actual gameplay crops labelled only with real level names; Apple captures have no added labels. These are browser captures of the app UI, not evidence of an iOS native/device test.
